commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Flying
Prince of Chaos — When Be'lakor enters, you draw X cards and you lose X life, where X is the number of Demons you control.
Lord of Torment — Whenever another Demon you control enters, it deals damage equal to its power to any target.

source_basis.known_approval_project_exceptions: Explicit user approval of Dream Devourer, Doom Whisperer, and Spark Double swaps; exact approved list preserved and fresh retrospective gate completed 2026-10-14.

strategy.primary: Demon tribal: assemble a board of high-power Demons, turn each Demon arrival into direct damage equal to its power, and refill with Be'lakor's ETB draw; multiply arrivals with Panharmonicon, Roaming Throne and copy effects.
strategy.secondary: Cheat and reanimate big Demons (Sneak Attack, Reanimate, Patriarch's Bidding, Whip of Erebos) and the Liliana's Contract alternate win.

role.advances_plan: Lord of Torment converts every Demon ETB into removal or face damage, and Prince of Chaos refuels; copies of Be'lakor (Spark Double, Rite of Replication) are the biggest turns.
role.honest_note: Six mana and needs other Demons; the draw costs life equal to cards drawn. Slow without ramp.

identity_core.why: Only source of Demon-ETB damage and the tribal draw.
Kicked on Be'lakor it is a one-card table kill.
Doubles every Lord of Torment trigger.
Approved swap: a second Be'lakor without the legend rule.
Puts the eight-drops in for one red and triggers Lord.
